text:
Hi James,

I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in data work and administrative support. I’d be glad to help with uploading videos, taking screenshots, and keeping your LMS organized and up to date.

My background includes SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard work, data cleaning, and data visualization, so I’m comfortable handling detail-oriented tasks accurately and consistently. I also understand the importance of following clear instructions, keeping files organized, and completing repetitive admin work reliably without needing heavy supervision.

One relevant project I completed was Shopify customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home. I built customer segments from Shopify order exports by recency, frequency, and spend, and fed them to the email tool. As a result, the top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and email revenue increased by 19%. That project strengthened my ability to work carefully with structured data, manage exports, and support operational workflows end to end.

For your BJJ app, I can help with the non-editing tasks you described: uploading videos, capturing screenshots, and making sure everything is placed correctly in the LMS. I’m comfortable with simple, repeatable workflows and can stay organized across multiple assets. I also understand that you need proof that the worker practices Brazilian Jiu Jitsu, and I’m prepared to provide that as requested.

If you’re looking for someone dependable, detail-focused, and easy to work with, I’d be happy to support this role. I can start quickly and follow your process closely so the content gets handled efficiently.

Best,
Mina Castellan
